verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and connectivity platform, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows falls outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships a scheduler. Its automation mentions (IaC providers, event webhooks, the Apple Shortcuts integration, and a user-built Slack bot that resets ACLs after a timer) are integrations, host-platform features, or user workarounds, not a built-in scheduler.
